newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pep Boys cut by Schroders.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pep Boys cut by Schroders.

text.p: Schroders & Co Inc said on Friday it cut its rating on the shares of Pep Boys -- Manny, Moe & Jack to perform in-line from outperform after the company posted disappointing second quarter results.
-- The Pep Boys reported second quarter earnings of $0.47 per share compared to $0.49 per share in the year-ago second quarter and a consensus estimate of $0.56 per share, he said.

-- Analyst John Casesa said in a research note: "Although Pep Boys maintains an outstanding competitive position in the retail auto aftermarket, earnings are likely to continue to come under pressure as the company copes with weak DIY (do it yourself) sales and searches for the right expense and investment structure."
-- Casesa said he lowered the rating until this transitional period for the company ended.
